title: Check-in desk
persona: You are a polite airline check-in agent at Istanbul Airport. The passenger is checking in for an international flight.
briefTr: Lizbon uçuşun için check-in bankosundasın. Yanında bir bavul var.
opening: Good morning. May I see your passport, please?

facts.question: Which gate was your flight at?

goals.instruction: The passenger hands over their passport, for example by saying 'Here you are'.
goals.retryReply: I'll need your passport to check you in.

goals.instruction: The passenger says where they are flying (any city).

goals.ask: Are you checking any bags today?
goals.instruction: The passenger says whether they are checking a bag, for example 'Yes, one suitcase' or 'No, just carry-on'.
goals.successReply: Please put it on the scale.
goals.retryReply: Do you have a suitcase to check in, or just carry-on?

goals.ask: Did you pack your bag yourself?
goals.instruction: The passenger confirms they packed the bag themselves.
goals.retryReply: It's a security question — did you pack the bag yourself?

goals.ask: Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
goals.instruction: The passenger chooses a seat: window, aisle or middle.
goals.retryReply: Would you prefer to sit by the window or by the aisle?

twists.intro: Oh — your suitcase is four kilos over the limit.
twists.instruction: The suitcase is too heavy. The passenger offers to move things to their carry-on, asks about the fee, or asks to check it as a second bag.
twists.retryReply: I'm afraid it's over the limit. What would you like to do?

options.text: Can I move some things to my carry-on?
options.reply: Sure, take your time. … That's perfect now.

options.text: How much is the extra fee?
options.reply: It's 40 euros. I'll add it to your booking.

options.text: Can I check it as a second bag?
options.reply: Yes, you can split it into two bags. Here's a tag.

twists.intro: I'm afraid your flight is delayed by two hours.
twists.instruction: The flight is delayed. The passenger reacts usefully: asks about a connecting flight, a lounge, or a meal voucher.
twists.retryReply: I'm sorry for the delay. Is there anything I can help you with?

options.reply: Your connection is protected — we'll rebook you automatically if needed.

options.text: Is there a lounge I can use?
options.reply: Yes, the lounge is on the second floor. Show your boarding pass at the desk.

options.text: Can I get a meal voucher?
options.reply: Of course. Here's a meal voucher for any café after security.

twists.intro: Also, your gate has changed to {gate}, and it's quite far from here.
twists.instruction: The gate changed and is far away. The passenger asks where it is, how long it takes to walk, or about a shuttle.
twists.retryReply: It's a bit far, so leave a little early. Any questions about getting there?

options.reply: After security, turn left and follow the signs.

options.text: How long does it take to walk there?
options.reply: About fifteen minutes, so don't stop for too long at the shops.

options.text: Is there a shuttle to the gate?
options.reply: Yes, a small train runs every five minutes after security.

closing: Here's your boarding pass. Gate {gate}, boarding at {boarding}. Have a nice flight!
